cd /app/work && timeout 170 python3 -c "
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import gen3, boundary
rng=random.Random(7)
t0=time.time(); made=0; guard=0
while made<60 and guard<2400:
    guard+=1
    big = rng.random()<0.25
    ts=time.time()
    r=gen3.gen(rng,big=big,failures=(rng.random()<0.6))
    dt=time.time()-ts
    if dt>2: print('slow gen', round(dt,2), 'big',big)
    if r is None: continue
    if rng.random()<0.45:
        ts=time.time()
        mm=boundary.min_migration_and_mlu(r)
        dt2=time.time()-ts
        if dt2>2: print('slow lp', round(dt2,2))
        if mm is not None:
            r2=boundary.variant(r,rng,'cap_exact')
            if r2 is not None: r=r2
    made+=1
print('made',made,'total',round(time.time()-t0,2),'guard',guard)
"
